login.heading: Sign in to the portal
login.forgotPin: Can't remember your PIN or your code? Ask Human Resources to reset it. It is never sent by email or by any link.

sessionExpired.title: Your session has expired
sessionExpired.advice: For security, the session closes after a few hours. Sign in again with your code and PIN and you will be back where you were.

originLocked.title: Too many attempts from this connection
originLocked.advice: Try again in {minutes} minute. | Try again in {minutes} minutes.
originLocked.alternative: You can also try from another connection or ask Human Resources for help.
originLocked.countdown: The "Sign in" button will be available in {time}.

privacy.heading: Data protection notice
privacy.controllerUnknown: Controller: the company that owns this workplace.
privacy.purpose: Purpose: so you can check your own daily working-time record (art. 34.9 of the Workers' Statute).
privacy.basis: Legal basis: compliance with a legal obligation.
privacy.retention: Retention: as long as the applicable regulations require.
privacy.retentionYears: Retention: {count} year, as required by the applicable regulations. | Retention: {count} years, as required by the applicable regulations.
privacy.rights: Your rights: to access your data and to ask for it to be corrected if it is inaccurate. Because the processing rests on a legal obligation, other rights (erasure, objection, portability) may be limited. Ask Human Resources.
privacy.complaint: If you think your data is not being handled properly, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).
privacy.noBiometrics: This system does not process biometric data.
privacy.policyPending: The full policy is available from Human Resources.

common.loadingSlow: This is taking longer than usual. You can keep waiting or try again.

errors.retryAfter: You can try again in {seconds} s.

network.title: Could not reach the server
network.advice: Check your connection and try again. Nothing you have done has been lost.

unauthenticated.title: Your session has expired
unauthenticated.advice: Sign in again with your code and your PIN to keep checking your record.

invalidCredentials.title: The employee code or the PIN are not correct
invalidCredentials.advice: Check them and try again. After several failed attempts, access is blocked for a few minutes, even if you then type the correct PIN. If you cannot sign in, ask Human Resources to reset your PIN.

forbidden.title: This information cannot be shown
forbidden.advice: Sign in again. If the problem continues, talk to Human Resources.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.advice: Go back to my record and reload the page.

conflict.title: Something changed in the meantime
conflict.advice: Reload the page and try again.

validation.title: There is something to review in the dates
validation.advice: Fix the period shown and try again.

rateLimited.title: Too many attempts in a row
rateLimited.advice: Wait a few seconds and try again.

unavailable.title: The portal cannot handle this request right now
unavailable.advice: It is not something you did. Tell Human Resources if it happens again.

unexpected.title: An unexpected error has occurred
unexpected.advice: Try again. If it happens again, tell Human Resources with the time and what you were doing.

timeout.title: The server is taking longer than usual
timeout.advice: We did not get a reply in time. You can try again now or wait a little; nothing you have done has been lost.

portalNetworkRestricted.title: The portal does not open from this network
portalNetworkRestricted.advice: Connect to the hotel network and try again. If you are already on it, talk to Human Resources.

notFound.heading: This page does not exist
notFound.description: The portal only has two screens: your record and downloading your history.

myRecords.title: My working time record
myRecords.subtitle: Your work days, your shifts and the total for each day. A shift that started at 22:00 belongs to the day it started, even if it ended the next day. Nothing is ever deleted: if something was corrected, it is explained below.

summary.label: Period summary
summary.days: {count} work day with records, from {from} to {to}. | {count} work days with records, from {from} to {to}.
summary.provisional: This total may still change: {count} work day has an open shift, a pending review or a total that does not match its shifts. | This total may still change: {count} work days have an open shift, a pending review or a total that does not match their shifts.
summary.todayEmpty: You have no clock-in recorded today yet.

filters.fromHint: Based on the date the work day started.
filters.toHint: Last day included. Left blank: last 31 days.
filters.inverted: The period ends before it starts. Check both dates.
filters.tooWide: The period cannot exceed {days} days. Check your history in shorter stretches.

empty.title: No work days in this period
empty.description: This is not a search error: you have no recorded clockings on those days. Try another period.

announce.results: {count} work day between {from} and {to}. | {count} work days between {from} and {to}.

flags.openShiftHint: You have not clocked out of this shift yet: today's total will still go up.
flags.incidentHint: A shift on this day was flagged for someone to review. It is not your mistake.

entries.caption: Shifts for the work day on {date}
entries.queuedNoMoment: Arrived {delay} after you clocked (kiosk offline queue). What counts is the time you clocked.
entries.queued: Received {moment}, {delay} after you clocked (kiosk offline queue). What counts is the time you clocked.
entries.empty: This work day has no current shift. If there are corrections below, they were voided: the history is still complete.
entries.mismatch: The recorded total for the day does not match the sum of its shifts. Both numbers are shown without choosing one: tell Human Resources before using these hours for anything.

sources.manual_admin: Entered by hand by Human Resources

history.heading: Correction history
history.empty: This work day has not been corrected: the shifts are the ones recorded when you clocked.
history.notice: Nothing is ever deleted or overwritten: every correction keeps what it said before, with who made it, when and why.
history.caption: What the correction on {moment} changed

myExport.title: Download my history
myExport.intro: Download your working time record as a file you can keep or hand over to whoever needs it.

contents.entries: One row for every shift worked, with clock in, clock out, duration and the total for each work day.
contents.corrections: One row for every correction to your record, with who made it, when and why.
contents.format: CSV or PDF file, with times as HH:MM, never as a decimal. The PDF is a sealed document you can show to a third party.
contents.zone: Every time in the PDF is in the centre's time zone ({zone}), the same one you see on screen, not your phone's or computer's.
contents.zoneUnknown: Every time in the PDF is in the centre's time zone, not your phone's or computer's.

filters.fromHint: Left blank, the last year is downloaded. At most one year per download.
filters.inverted: The period ends before it starts. Check both dates.

pdfUnavailable.title: The PDF cannot be generated right now
pdfUnavailable.advice: It is nothing you did. You can download the same history as CSV, or try the PDF again later.

pdfBusy.message: There are a lot of PDF downloads right now. Try again in {seconds} seconds, or download the CSV, which is always available.
pdfBusy.messageNoWait: There are a lot of PDF downloads right now. Try again in a moment, or download the CSV, which is always available.
pdfBusy.messageReady: You can try the PDF again now, or download the CSV, which is always available.

myExport.empty: You have no work days in that period. The file was downloaded anyway, but it only has the criteria header: try other dates.

announce.done: Download ready. Check your device's downloads.
announce.empty: No work days in that period. The file was downloaded, with the criteria header only.
